scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -k -n web,api "npm run dev -w @navifree/web" "npm run dev -w @navifree/api"
scripts.build:shared: npm run build -w @navifree/core && npm run build -w @navifree/api-client
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @navifree/api && npm run build -w @navifree/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @navifree/api && node --test tests/*.test.cjs
